snippet.title: 🌱 Next Acre – A Cozy Farming Card Game
snippet.description:
🌱 Next Acre – A Cozy Farming Card Game

Build your own little farm, one card at a time!

Grow crops, raise animals, combine cards, craft delicious recipes, and develop production chains as your farm grows. Complete village orders, unlock new buildings, discover recipes, and automate your farm with helpful workers.

🌾 Grow crops and raise animals
🍳 Craft recipes and build production chains
📦 Complete village orders
⚙️ Unlock helpers and automate your farm
🏡 Discover new content as your farm expands

🎮 Launching November 19, 2026 on Steam!

🌟 Wishlist Next Acre on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4857380/Next_Acre/

Thank you for supporting indie games! ❤️

#NextAcre #CozyGames #FarmingGame #IndieGames #Steam
